title: IG POST v8.1
desc: v8: legge il TESTO dello schermo (uiautomator dump) invece degli screenshot; il relay su ngrok sceglie il commento con il bot Hermes commentbot e restituisce le coordinate esatte del suo Reply; blocco se il nome nella casella non coincide; 40% e memoria nel relay; END ferma lo scroll a fine commenti.

config.content: sh -c 'dumpsys activity top | grep -q direct_inbox_action_bar && input keyevent 4 || echo home'

sh -c 'rm -f /sdcard/u.xml /data/local/tmp/u.xml; F=/sdcard/u.xml; E=$(uiautomator dump $F 2>&1); if [ ! -s $F ]; then F=/data/local/tmp/u.xml; E2=$(uiautomator dump --compressed $F 2>&1); fi; if [ -s $F ]; then curl -sk --max-time 30 -H "ngrok-skip-browser-warning: 1" -H "Content-Type: text/xml" --data-binary @$F "https://paying-cake-engulf.ngrok-free.dev/pick?acc=Melina%20Berner%20Frankfurt"; else curl -sk --max-time 30 -H "ngrok-skip-browser-warning: 1" --data-binary "DUMPERR 1: $E || 2: $E2" "https://paying-cake-engulf.ngrok-free.dev/pick?acc=Melina%20Berner%20Frankfurt"; fi'

config.script: async function main({ curlResp }) { const r=String(curlResp||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(); const no={ goPost:'0', goOn:'1', pickN:'0', tapX:'0', tapY:'0', useTap:'0', ocrAuthor:'', theReply:'' }; if(/^END/.test(r)) return Object.assign(no,{ goOn:'0' }); const p=r.split('|'); if(p[0]!=='PICK'||p.length<6) return no; const x=parseInt(p[2],10)||0, y=parseInt(p[3],10)||0; return { goPost:'1', goOn:'1', pickN: x>0?'0':p[1], tapX:String(x), tapY:String(y), useTap: x>0?'1':'0', ocrAuthor:p[4], theReply:p.slice(5).join('|') }; }
async function main({ prefill }) { const s=String(prefill||'').trim(); const m=/^@([A-Za-z0-9._]{2,30})/.exec(s); return { pfUser: m?('@'+m[1]):'', via: m?'T':'C' }; }

async function main({ confResp }) { let r=String(confResp||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(); r=r.replace(/^["']+|["']+$/g,'').trim(); const bad=(!r)||/NO_MATCH/i.test(r)||r.charAt(0)==='{'||r.charAt(0)==='<'||r.length>220; return { goType: bad?'0':'1', finalText: bad?'':r }; }
